name: xulsword

scripts.start:appSrv: webpack --env development --env appSrv --env preload && cross-env LD_LIBRARY_PATH='./Cpp/lib' electron ./build/app/dist/appSrv/server.cjs --ozone-platform=x11
scripts.start:webappSrv: webpack --env development --env webappSrv && cross-env LD_LIBRARY_PATH='./Cpp/lib' node ./build/webapp
scripts.build:app: yarn build:clean && webpack --env packaged --env production --env preload --env appSrv --env appClients
scripts.check: yarn pretty && yarn typescript && yarn lint && yarn lint:css
scripts.package: yarn build:clean && yarn build:app && electron-builder build --publish never
scripts.package-publish: yarn build:clean && yarn build:app && electron-builder build --publish always
scripts.package-linux: cross-env PKLIB=linux yarn install-libxulsword && yarn package --linux
scripts.package-32win: cross-env PKLIB=32win yarn install-libxulsword && yarn package --win --ia32 && cross-env PKLIB=linux yarn install-libxulsword
scripts.package-64win: cross-env PKLIB=64win yarn install-libxulsword && yarn package --win --x64 '-c.nsis.artifactName=${productName} Setup 64.${version}.${ext}' -c.publish.provider=github -c.publish.channel=latest-x64 && cross-env PKLIB=linux yarn install-libxulsword
scripts.package-mac: cross-env PKLIB=darwin yarn install-libxulsword && yarn package --mac zip --x64 --arm64 && cross-env PKLIB=linux yarn install-libxulsword
scripts.package-mac-dmg: cross-env PKLIB=darwin yarn install-libxulsword && yarn package --mac dmg --universal && node ./scripts/dmgCompress.mjs
scripts.release: node ./scripts/clean.mjs release && yarn release-linux && yarn release-32win && yarn release-mac
scripts.release-linux: yarn && cross-env PKLIB=linux yarn install-libxulsword && yarn package-publish --linux
scripts.release-32win: yarn && cross-env PKLIB=32win yarn install-libxulsword && yarn package-publish --win --ia32 && cross-env PKLIB=linux yarn install-libxulsword
scripts.release-64win: yarn && cross-env PKLIB=64win yarn install-libxulsword && yarn package-publish --win --x64 '-c.nsis.artifactName=${productName} Setup 64.${version}.${ext}' -c.publish.provider=github -c.publish.channel=latest-x64 && cross-env PKLIB=linux yarn install-libxulsword
scripts.release-mac: yarn && cross-env PKLIB=darwin yarn install-libxulsword && yarn package-publish --mac zip --x64 --arm64 && cross-env PKLIB=linux yarn install-libxulsword

//: @blueprintjs/core is pinned to 6.8.1, with select and table pinned to the versions built for it, because from 6.9.0 Blueprint's component CSS uses color-mix() with no fallback, which breaks button colors and borders in browsers older than Chrome 111, Safari 16.2 and Firefox 113 (see CSS browser support in CLAUDE.md). Check a newer version's lib/css/blueprint.css before upgrading. These versions declare React 18 only (React 19 from 6.16.0), so yarn warns about peers, but they use no API that React 19 removed.
